newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets launch raid in northeast Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets launch raid in northeast Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes launched a raid deep into Lebanon on Thursday morning, targetting suspected guerrilla targets in northeast Lebanon, security sources said.

They said the air attack targeted suspected guerrilla targets on the banks of the Assi River in Hermel region some 55 km (33 miles) north of the city of Baalbek and only 10 km (six miles) west of the border with Syria.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the raid, which followed the killing of one Israeli soldier and the wounding of three others in a Hizbollah guerrilla raid on Wednesday.

Hizbollah (Party of God) is leading a guerrilla war to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep zone in south Lebanon set up by Israel to stop cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
